prior_year_events.impact_description: 2018 underwriting year was reinsured to close externally resulting in the Syndicate having only transactions relating to 2019 to 2021 underwriting years during the 2021 financial year.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 58.723m. During 2021 there was a small adverse prior-year development of GBP 0.764m (approximately 1.3% of opening reserves), i.e. a modest strengthening of prior-year reserves. The movements in gross claims outstanding were also affected by Reinsurance-to-Close activity (RITC of closed years) which materially reduced certain closed-year gross balances. The prior-year change arises from re-estimation of prior accident years rather than the current accident year.
raw_causal_phrases: estimates of claims subsequently prove to be insufficient (reserving risk)
changes in external or market factors such as public attitudes to claiming, economic conditions, levels of claims inflation, judicial decisions and legislation

lob_movements.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior-year development taken from Note 8 reconciliation line 'Claims incurred in the prior accident years' (gross) = GBP 764k. There is material RITC activity (RITC of closed years GBP 14.403m gross) which affects comparability of gross balances; no explicit narrative sentence quantifying gross prior-year reserve movement was found, so the numeric PYD is taken from the technical provisions reconciliation table. Lob mapping for movements was derived from the gross liabilities by segment table. Exact verbatim reserve-movement sentence was not present; exact_reserve_text left empty.
